decisions.reason: The startup accelerator is peripheral to the core recycling machinery business, but it costs little to run and supports the firm's partnership-driven brand, so it stays for now despite a real risk of being cut.

The bio-based CO2-negative binder is still presented as a flagship of the firm's direction and needs a long adoption cycle, so management keeps it despite its distance from the core plastic and oil technology.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core modular WASTX line and fits the decentralized strategy directly, so it is very likely to remain on the market.
